entities.summary: Iman Hasan Mohammed Al-Rufaye, also known as Eman Hassane Al-Rufei, is an Iraqi chess player who holds the FIDE title of Woman International Master (WIM). She is a Women's Chess Olympiads individual gold (1998) and silver medals winner.
